title: Volcanoes of Japan (timed)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Japan, one after another. You have 45 seconds for each place; at zero your marker is locked in. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Fujisan
rounds.fact: Fujisan is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1707. The data places it in Japan.

rounds.name: Akita-Yakeyama
